== Overview ==

Rearmonia is an international Tibia 7.6 OTS with fast-attack combat, custom map, crafting, mining, prey system, daily bosses, charms, imbuements and OTCv8 client. Register a free account and join the adventure! This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
